headline: Rookey build
title: Rookey Best Build | Break Machine | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Rookey is a Break specialist, so build it that way. Take Bouncy Sling and Guardbreak Slam, and put your stat points into Break, then physical defense. Equip the Gargantuan Horn and aim for an ESTP personality. Open with Bouncy Sling, then use Guardbreak Slam, which can smash three times in a row. The third smash stuns the target for one second. Do you run Rookey? Comment below!
description: Rookey best build in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Bouncy Sling and Guardbreak Slam, Break then physical defense, Gargantuan Horn, ESTP personality.
